title: To Lie or Not to Lie? Investigating The Biased Spread of Global Lies by LLMs
reasoning: The paper introduces GlobalLies, a benchmark dataset for evaluating misinformation generation in LLMs. This evaluation is a core safety and ethics concern. Furthermore, the benchmark explicitly includes 'Religious Group' as one of its seven core entity categories (alongside Country, City, etc.), and evaluates how LLMs handle harmful misinformation targeting religious groups and religious leaders across different languages and regions.
